<div class="facts"><div class="fact"><small>Error ID</small><b>ST-AUTH-004</b></div><div class="fact"><small>Area</small><b>Sign-in and access</b></div><div class="fact"><small>HTTP status</small><b>401</b></div><div class="fact"><small>API error code</small><b>15</b></div><div class="fact wide"><small>Where you see it</small><b>Login page, which then opens the &quot;set a new password&quot; page</b></div></div>

<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>User password expired!</span></div>

<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>The entered password violates the password policy. Set a new password.</span></div>

## Why it happens

From the release after 4.3.0.57. The password policy under **Security settings** has an expiration period that has passed, or **Force to reset password if not valid** is on and the current password no longer meets the policy, for example after the minimum length was raised. In 4.3.0.57 the policy is not applied, so this error does not occur.

## Fix it

Set a new password on the page that opens. It must meet the policy shown there. For REST clients, the error body carries a `resetToken` to set the new password with.

## Check that it worked

You are signed in with the new password.
